Building: Coit Tower, San Francisco (monument tower).
The front (−z) is the parking circle side.
Footprint: 21.9 m along x by 22.2 m along z, centred on the origin.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. whole fluted concrete tower on its hilltop with trees below, clear sky
  2. tower rising behind the Telegraph Hill apartment building, showing the full shaft and the arcaded crown, flag on top
  3. high oblique aerial of the tower and the circular drive and park on Telegraph Hill

json.notes: Coit Tower is a slender, fluted reinforced-concrete cylinder on a hilltop, about 64 m tall, with a short wider base and a crown of arched openings under a plain cap. Its pale grey-cream concrete and tapering shaft are the defining features, so I model a tapered fluted-looking drum, a wider plinth, and an arcaded observation crown.

final.notes: Coit Tower is a slender, fluted reinforced-concrete cylinder on a hilltop, about 64 m tall, with a short wider base and a crown of arched openings under a plain cap. Its pale grey-cream concrete and tapering shaft are the defining features, so I model a tapered fluted-looking drum, a wider plinth, and an arcaded observation crown.
